title: Illustrator Biography Website
content: Jim Vadeboncoeur,a leading collector, historian, and publisher of early illustration, has just revamped his website.His illustrated biographies of storytelling painters from before 1923 are some of the best on the Web. As a publisher, he has produced some excellent collections of black and white images by early illustrators.JVJ Publishing Gallery of Early Illustrators BiographiesEverett Raymond Kinstler: The Artist's Journey Through Popular Culture, 1942-1962JVJ Publishing
